name: easydistribution-catalog
description: Каталог поставщика с персональными ценами: backend (Express + MySQL) и frontend (React + Vite)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm --prefix frontend run dev"
